article.title: Lay cousellor-delivered wisdom-enhancement narrative-therapy and empathy-focused interventions to reduce loneliness among older adults: A three-arm randomized controlled trial.
article.authors: Jiang D, Tang VFY, Chow EO
article.abstract: Given the high prevalence and substantial adverse effects of loneliness, scalable psychosocial interventions to alleviate loneliness among older adults must be rigorously evaluated. Existing interventions focus on addressing perceived weaknesses rather than leveraging older adults strengths to mitigate loneliness. The objective is to assess the 6 and 12 months efficacy of two telephone-based interventions-wisdom enhancement narrative therapy (Tele-NT) and an empathy-focused intervention (Tele-EP)-compared with an active control group (ACG) in reducing loneliness.
